ارتضختا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخَتَا (irtaḍaḵatā) /ir.ta.dˤa.xa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخَتَا (urtuḍiḵatā) /ur.tu.dˤi.xa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
